title: Among all expansion-type sets that have Japanese translations, find the Ita
question: Among all expansion-type sets that have Japanese translations, find the Italian-translated names of cards illustrated by Chippy, ordered by descending converted mana cost.

prediction.sql:
SELECT fd."XCL_079"
FROM cards AS c
JOIN sets AS s ON c."XCL_063" = s."XCL_099"
JOIN set_translations AS st ON s."XCL_099" = st."XCL_093"
JOIN foreign_data AS fd ON c."XCL_072" = fd."XCL_082"
WHERE s."XCL_115" = 'expansion'
  AND st."XCL_092" = 'Japanese'
  AND c."XCL_002" = 'Chippy'
  AND fd."XCL_077" = 'Italian'
ORDER BY c."XCL_011" DESC
